visual.general_description: Color photograph of several nude newborns lying on blue surgical drapes in an operating-room setting.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph taken at an angle from above. Several newborns lie on and between blue surgical drapes: one at upper left lying on its side with the head turned down and blurred, one at upper right on its back with a white clamp at the umbilical stump and the head turned away, one at middle left lying on its side with a blue band on the wrist and only the ear and side of the head visible with the face turned away, and one only partly visible along the bottom edge, cut off, with a hand over the face. At lower right a yellowish sheathed limb lies beside an infant foot bearing a blue band. Small dark ink marks are on the skin of the torsos. A thin tube or cable runs diagonally across the drapes. Staff in blue gowns are partly visible at the top and right edges, and metal equipment and a bottle are at upper left. No printed text, labels, arrows or scale are legible.
